name: Daily annoyance -> fixed
mechanism: Open on a relatable everyday frustration, then show 2-3 verified features that remove it, ending on how the day feels now.

hook.pattern: Name a specific, common frustration in the viewer's own words
examples: Capek nggak sih HP lowbat pas lagi di jalan?
Foto malam selalu burem? Sama, dulu.

beats.guidance: The frustration, said plainly. On-screen text = the frustration as a question.
First verified feature that addresses it.
Optional third verified feature or a detail shot.
Life after: one sentence on how the routine is easier now. No new claims.

cta: Direct but friendly: 'cek di keranjang/link bawah'
